summary: @or-sdk/idw-public preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory and then executes a shipped 727 KB Bun-compiled JavaScript file (math_init.js) using that runtime. math_init.js is a single-line, string-array-obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers, a ~2000-entry numeric/string constant array, and a rotator function that shifts the array). The advertised purpose of the package is a small SDK exposing a class with zod schemas; there is no legitimate need to fetch an alternate runtime and execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle at install time. Because the payload is compiled for and executed by the freshly-downloaded Bun runtime, its behavior is opaque to Node-based inspection on the installer host, and the code runs automatically on `npm install` before any user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
